cohort: Preterm very low birth weight neonates admitted at Muhimbili National Hospital (MNH).
finding: The proportion of very low birth weight (VLBW) neonates with intraventricular hemorrhage (IVH) was 22.9%, and mortality was two times higher among VLBW neonates with IVH compared to those without IVH.
mod_finding: Univariate analysis showed mode of delivery to be associated with an increased risk of IVH, but it was not an independent predictor in multivariate analysis.
